ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast ratio with dominant high-intensity white pixels (approx. 85% surface area) and low-intensity black pixels (approx. 15% surface area) localized on the margins and focal spots.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white regions across both lobes. A thick, continuous black perimeter band (5-30 pixels width) along the trailing edge. Distinct black focal spots including one prominent circular blob on the mid-left lobe and scattered micro-mottling across the lower sections of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped notch with an internal angle of approximately 45 degrees, bordered by high-contrast black pigmentation.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel amplitudes of 2-15 pixels along the trailing edge. Significant rounded tubercles (peaks) are localized on the distal tips of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Sigmoidal curve fitting; concave trajectory originating from the median notch, transitioning to convex curves toward the terminal distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density cluster of circular white high-contrast pixel groups (barnacle colonization) localized on the right distal tip. Individual white circular spots are sparsely distributed across the central ventral surface of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Series of three distinct, dark, diagonal linear streaks (rake marks) visible on the right lobe. Fragmented, thinner linear disruptions visible on the lower section of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant biological encrustations (barnacles) localized on the trailing edge tips and leading edge corners. Parallel linear scarring (rake marks) on the right fluke ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique, solitary, high-contrast black circular spot located on the mid-left fluke lobe.
